content:
noah: Heads-up: Enterprise AE on call with DeltaWorks. They want a one-off 35% discount for a 90-day POC and commit 220k tokens/mo. CPQ shows discount field but no approval ticket. Need fast routing, call in 45m.

jess: 35% > auto cap (30%). That triggers deal desk + finance. If you can set CPQ `special_approval` = true and `commit_band` = "200-299k" it should trigger manual routing.

arjun: If it's day-of and customer needs a yes now, Deal Desk can request expedited finance review. Use POST /internal/dealroute with {opp, expedite:true}. I can run it.

noah: opp 0082H00002DqWx9. Setting CPQ now.

deal-desk-bot: New route request created DD-13021 for opp 0082H00002DqWx9. Labels: [expedite, day-of]. Assigned: arjun. SLA: initial ack in 2 hours.

arjun: Pinged finance and included revenue recognition notes (prepay 90d). Also attached standard POC addendum template. Finance, can you give a quick thumbs?

finance: Reviewed DD-13021. Quick decision: can approve up to 33% for 220k commit with addendum requiring 30-day usage review and capped overage pricing. 35% requires CRO sign-off.

noah: Customer pushing hard, asking if we can do 35 now and CRO will sign later.

arjun: We can't commit 35 without CRO. I recommended counter 33% with addendum. I also flagged DD-13021 for CRO escalation if AE wants to pursue 35.

deal-desk-bot: DD-13021 updated: finance counter 33% + addendum. If AE requests escalation, reroute to CRO queue.

noah: AE accepted 33% on call. Marking opp as verbal agreement. Will upload signed addendum when complete. Thanks all. :pray:
